requirements: Preserve immutable Page 0 and source-backed replay obligations.
A Funnel receipt may mint only one execution claim.
A Harness execution claim may be consumed only once.
Harness stage navigation cannot skip pipeline order.
Raw Harness intake and modifications route back through the Funnel.
Every product/repository PR carries a deterministic Funnel proof.
Funnel-law changes require owner cryptographic authorization after one-time key bootstrap.
The PR guardian executes trusted base-branch validator code.
Final repository enforcement requires protected main with sealed-funnel required.

done_criteria: Receipt replay cannot mint a second Harness claim.
Claim replay cannot be consumed a second time.
A post-authorization Funnel write invalidates Harness authority.

PR proof validation runs from trusted base-branch code.

Natural-speech filler does not replace the user's actual hard constraints.
